findings.title: The sample panel shows only tide times, which any almanac already gives

location.description: the "Today at Porthmellin" panel, with four tide rows only

findings.viewer_experience: A harbor master sees a table their almanac already gives them. Lock gate times, pontoon depth and notices appear only as text claims in the row below, and nothing compares Tidewell with how the office posts these today.

current.value: 4 tide rows; no gate-time row, no pontoon depth, no notice, no before-and-after

findings.target: The panel shows a gate-time row, a pontoon depth reading, one notice, and a short before-and-after against the office's current method.
findings.fix_direction: Add a gate-time row, a pontoon depth reading, one notice, and a short before-and-after against the office's current method. The maker must supply the real gate times, depth figures, notice text and current method.

closed_when.check: In the desktop, phone, tablet and widescreen images, the "Today at Porthmellin" panel shows a gate-time row, a pontoon depth reading, one notice, and a before-and-after against the office's current method, not only the four tide rows.

findings.title: The panel moved right and narrowed, leaving a gap that splits the page in two

location.description: the space between the hero text and the panel

findings.viewer_experience: The page looks a little split in two, but it reads clearly.

current.value: a gap of about 277 px between the hero text and the 299 px panel

findings.target: A smaller gap between the hero text and the panel.
findings.fix_direction: If it matters, widen the hero text column a little toward the panel.

closed_when.check: In the desktop and widescreen images, the gap between the hero text and the panel is visibly smaller and the page does not read as split in two.

findings.title: Two feature notes on the phone run under 45 characters per line

location.description: the second feature note under "Depth at the pontoon"

findings.viewer_experience: They read normally at this width.
findings.target: characters per line of 45 or more, or accept the shortfall at this width
findings.fix_direction: Reduce the side padding a little, or accept the shortfall at this width.

closed_when.check: characters_per_line of section.points > div.point:nth-of-type(1) > p and section.points > div.point:nth-of-type(2) > p in the phone viewport is 45 or more
